solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

B056-01.notes: Area 10 m^2 / 0.25 m^2 per tile = 40. (Also 5 x 8 tiles.)

B056-03.notes: 15% of 40 = 6. C (34) is the 'correct' count trap.

B056-04.notes: h = sqrt(100-36) = 8; V = (1/3)pi(36)(8) = 96pi. Using slant height gives 120pi (not offered).

B056-06.notes: 1 ft = 30.48 cm; 30.48^2 = 929.03 cm^2. A is the unsquared trap.

B056-08.notes: Sum increases by 55; mean increases by 5.5 -> 25.5.

B056-09.notes: Squares: 10; cubes: 1,8,27,64 = 4; both: 1,64 = 2. 12/100 = 3/25. D = no overlap removed, C = only one overlap removed. Overlap trap may push it near hard boundary.

flags: minor: 'for every integer x' is fine; function-notation recursion may look unfamiliar but is one routine step (2 + 10*3).
